name: Coastal Roadways Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1968, Coastal Roadways Ltd is in the business of Freight Transportation and 
Warehouse Management.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
CRL provides end-to-end logistics services, including transportation and warehousing, with road transport as its core business. It operates a fleet of 525+ owned and attached vehicles, moving over 40,000 consignments nationwide each year. The company handles more than 5 lakh tons of diverse cargo annually—from heavy machinery to consumer durables, pharmaceuticals, and sensitive electrical and telecom cables—and operates 40+ company-owned branches across key business hubs.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.56 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.60% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 7.82% over last 3 years.
